correctness.rationale: PASS: Exact 3-round Ehrenfeucht–Fraïssé recursion records the complete atomic equality and multiplication diagrams over zero and three chosen elements, recursively collecting all possible child-type sets. The inspected C++ source implements structural equality of these diagrams and nested sets; compiled and independently executed for all n=1..26, obtaining root classes 0,1,...,8,8,...,8. A separately implemented immutable Python recursion agrees for n=1..10. For arbitrary n,m>=26 a 3-move order game selecting up to two new endpoints per move has gap cutoff t_r=3t_(r-1)+2: 2,8,26; ordered equalities of selected six endpoints determine every relational multiplication atom. Thus tail equivalence is proved by induction, and the exact finite bridge U9~U26 gives the all-n sharp classification.
